summary: The single finding (low) is confirmed, with corrected scope. Route 3's part-ii title uses the parent's pre-RS-22 title 'Hecke correspondences and local shtuka cohomology', although the accepted RS-22 retitled HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukas 'Hecke correspondences on the Fargues–Fontaine curve and local shtuka cohomology' six days before the extraction. Corrections: the stale prefix is on twelve part-ii routes in nine extractions, not thirteen; the raw data/atlas.json snapshot, which make_queue.py reads, still has the old title, so the single pending job DESIGN-HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukasPartII (which merges all three proposed Part IIs by parent) is named with the old title whatever the routes say; and route titles have no mechanical effect. The authorised change is route 3's title in PAPER-HANSEN-26.result.json only; the rest is a maintainer note. Disclosure: this verifier wrote PAPER-FARGUES-SCHOLZE-21, whose route 11 joins this extraction's route 1; that route is not under review here and was not judged.

Read the abstract, §1 and §2.2 on the use of [HKW22] (the character formula [HKW22, Theorem 6.5.2] and Proposition 2.7); the finding concerns a route title, not the paper's text.

findings.reason: Checked at 317cfd3d. None of the files involved has changed since the red team's input revision 7cd697e4: the extraction, its review, PAPER-HANSEN-KALETHA-WEINSTEIN-22.result.json, the other extractions named, data/restructure/RS-22.result.json, data/atlas.json, scripts/restructure.py, scripts/build.py and research/blueprint/make_queue.py. (a) The core claim holds. Route 3 of PAPER-HANSEN-26.result.json (part-ii, parent HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukas, roadmap HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukasKottwitzPartII) is titled 'Hecke correspondences and local shtuka cohomology, Part II: the Lefschetz–Verdier trace formula and the Kottwitz conjecture', identical to PAPER-HANSEN-KALETHA-WEINSTEIN-22 route 1. The accepted RS-22 (data/restructure/RS-22.result.json, roadmaps['HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukas']: action 'keep', title 'Hecke correspondences on the Fargues–Fontaine curve and local shtuka cohomology') retitled the parent; REV-RS-22 was committed 888c819c on 2026-09-23 12:26 UTC, after HKW22's extraction (49cbe88b, 2026-09-23 00:25 UTC) and before this extraction (ed768b0e, 2026-09-29 10:31 UTC) and its review (67454013, 2026-09-29 12:32 UTC). scripts/build.py applies accepted restructurings (restructure.apply_restructurings sets roadmap['title'] from the entry), so the published atlas carries the new title. PROTOCOL §16 asks for '<that roadmap's title>, Part II: <what it adds>', and the current title is RS-22's. The review's route-1 check of the title prefix was not repeated for route 3. Low is right: the title is presentation, and the item, its status and its owner are unaffected. The paper confirms the route's substance: it uses the character formula of [HKW22, Theorem 6.5.2] (§2.2) and needs it 'in its most general form' for Proposition 2.7(ii). (b) Corrections to the red team. First, the count is twelve part-ii routes to HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukas in nine extractions, not thirteen: GLEASON-LIM-XU-26 R11 and R12, HANSEN-26 R3, HANSEN-KALETHA-WEINSTEIN-22 R1, HE-21 R10, KISIN-17 R7, KISIN-PAPPAS-ZHOU-26 R7, SCHOLZE-WEINSTEIN-20 R4, VANHOFTEN-24 R7 and R9, ZHU-17 R15 and R17 (the red team's own list plus this route also gives twelve). Second, 'the atlas shows the new title' holds for the assembled atlas only: the raw snapshot data/atlas.json still has 'Hecke correspondences and local shtuka cohomology', and research/blueprint/make_queue.py reads that snapshot without applying restructurings. Third, a route's title does not name anything mechanically. make_queue.paper_designs groups every part-ii route by parent, so the Kottwitz, Integral and AffineDeligneLusztig proposals all feed the single pending job DESIGN-HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukasPartII, and that job's title is built from the parent's title in data/atlas.json; route titles are only quoted in its list of proposals. The queue therefore already names the job 'Hecke correspondences and local shtuka cohomology, Part II', and it would keep that name after the route edit. So the red team's suggestion that 'the queue generator should derive the prefix from it' misplaces the fault: it already derives it from the parent, but from the pre-restructure snapshot. Fourth, keeping HKW22's route in step is not needed for coalescing, which goes by parent, not by title or roadmap id. Authorised fix scope. Severity is low, so no FIX-RT job is generated; if the file is next edited for another reason, change only research/blueprint/papers/PAPER-HANSEN-26.result.json routes[2].title (route 3) to 'Hecke correspondences on the Fargues–Fontaine curve and local shtuka cohomology, Part II: the Lefschetz–Verdier trace formula and the Kottwitz conjecture', keeping the route at position 3 and leaving its id, parent, area, items, brief and reason unchanged, and re-run check_paper.py. PAPER-HANSEN-26.md does not quote the title and is not edited; the paper review is not edited. Out of scope for this finding: HKW22 route 1 and the other ten routes are not this red team's target. Maintainer notes, not fixer edits: (1) make_queue.py should title Part II design jobs from the atlas with accepted restructurings applied (apply_restructurings over data/restructure), since DESIGN-HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukasPartII is currently named with the pre-RS-22 title; (2) the twelve route titles listed above, including VANHOFTEN-24's older 'Hecke stacks and local shtukas' prefix, can be retitled in one sweep. Disclosure: this verifier wrote PAPER-FARGUES-SCHOLZE-21. That extraction has no route to HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukas; its route 11 coalesces with this extraction's route 1, which the finding does not concern and whose correctness this verdict does not judge.
